about: The intake's fixtures (PLAN.md WP-9.1a, G9): one clean submission and an idle that sways, three improvements (a CC0 clip's, a CC BY one's, and one of a clip whose mirrored twin is in the library, each sent as `m3a library submit --improves` sends it), and each planted bad one the plan and its verifiers name (the same idle frozen among them, F.13), built in code by tools/intake/fixtures.ts from a procedural gait or idle (motions no library clip has; `idle` names the idle) or a library clip, so nothing binary or long is committed. `compile` runs recipe steps over the library clip, `freeze` makes every key its first pose (a statue, as a fixed fit froze 100STYLE's idles, D133), `set` writes a field by its path (null removes it), `turn` turns a key field's first part by degrees at every key, `plant` plants one of tools/plant's defects, `approved` forges the owner's approval and an adoption record; `expect` is the state the checker leaves it in, `gate` and `reason` what its bounce must say; `bare` also plants a bad one into an existing set without the intake's provenance (with the fields it sets), as a pull request outside the intake would, for the library's gates.
